findings.description: The status scroll viewport is constrained between the safe-area top and fixed end button with clipping. Full multiline title content can scroll; the added UIKit test checks visible title/button intersection at both scroll extremes across five sizes and maximum Dynamic Type.

limitations: UIKit test execution timed out before any Test Suite/Test Case result; compile success is not runtime qualification.
This is a review of the R1 correction and its test assertions, not proof of all visitor/device/SIP behavior.
